p.seg: First Chapter
Virgin Descends the Mountain After Receiving Sword Techniques
Master Yuán Returns to His Cave After Stealing the Dharma Books
Creation and transformation are inherently limitless,
But all that contains sentiment belongs to one family.
If you don't believe that spirits can transform,
A whirlwind can blow down a living lamp flower.
It is said that during the Kāiyuán era of the Great Táng Dynasty,
in the Zhènzé region,
there was an official named Liú Zhíqīng,
who had served as a Remonstrance Official,
but after submitting a memorial impeaching the Prime Minister Lǐ Línfǔ and failing,
He resigned from his post and stayed at home.
The wife had once advised her husband not to be so talkative,
but now she couldn't help but retort a few times.
That official was an upright man,
how could he submit to such treatment?
Because of this, there were back-and-forths in their speech,
the wife felt unhappy,
and developed an illness.
She invited a doctor for treatment,
but her condition was sometimes good, sometimes bad,
and she couldn't fully recover.
One day at night,
the wife sat on the bed,
and ate a few mouthfuls of rice porridge.
She told her nursemaid to take away the porridge bowl.
She only saw the silver lamp was dim,
the nursemaid said:
"Madam,
congratulations, a big lamp flower!"
The wife said:
"What good news do I have?
Just trim it for me,
so that my eyes are clear,
and my heart feels refreshed."
The nursemaid went forward,
and using two fingers, picked up the lamp pick and trimmed it,
the red flame fell down,
suddenly the lamp light became bright,
Fell onto the table.
Immediately behind the lamp, a gust of cold wind arose,
causing the lamp flame to spin left and right,
like a fiery bead.
Yǎngniáng laughed:
"Fūrén is so playful,
the lamp flame has come to life!"
Before she finished speaking,
she saw the lamp flame spin three or four times,
spinning to become as large as a bowl,
a ball rolled to the ground,
with a "huā" sound,
like the sound of a firecracker.
The lamp flame burst open,
scattering sparks all over the ground,
and instantly disappeared.
Then a three-foot-long old woman appeared,
facing the Fūrén and offering blessings:
"This old woman heard of Fūrén's illness,
and has brought some immortal medicine here for Fūrén to take."
At first, the Fūrén was frightened,
but hearing her speak these words,
she took her for a manifestation of a deity,
and instead became delighted.
Truly, medicine can cure diseases that are not fated to cause death,
and the Buddha helps those with affinity.
She took the medicine then and there,
and although her illness was cured,
Later, this old woman actually became entangled with the Madame,
wanting to establish familial relations.
She would arrive in a four-man sedan chair,
with people shouting and crowding before and behind,
frequently coming to the house to make a commotion.
If you tried to send her away, she wouldn't leave,
and you couldn't treat her disrespectfully.
If anyone contradicted her with even a single word,
she would wave her hand,
and that person would immediately fall to the ground.
No one knew what kind of magic this was,
but a bloody heart and liver,
would already be held in her hand.
Only after everyone begged her bitterly,
would she throw the heart and liver into the air,
and it would naturally slip into the dead person's mouth,
and that dead person would be revived.
Because of this terrifying thing,
Liú Jiànyì's entire family was troubled,
and they secretly sent people to track down her dwelling place.
They saw her dive into the bottom of Yīngdòu Lake.
Think about it, what kind of water is Yīngdòu Lake?
How could one establish a home at the bottom of that water?
She must be a monster!
They repeatedly invited Dharma masters to write talismans and chant incantations,
but all failed to subdue her,
and instead suffered losses.
Only when the old monk of Nánlín Temple invited a Jiēdì Honorable God,
They set up an inescapable net,
dispatched divine generals to capture it,
revealing its true form,
which was a three-foot-long macaque monkey that had been causing trouble for many years.
That *Jiédì* was named *Lóngshù Wáng Púsà*,
*Liú Jiànyì* usually made offerings to this deity,
with utmost sincerity,
so today he especially came to rescue and protect,
to eliminate the demon and eradicate the trouble.
A poem says:
In life, never keep a macaque monkey,
its wild nature runs rampant and cannot be controlled;
Don't say the lamp flower becomes a strange anomaly,
its usual behavior is enduring lewdness and theft.
That macaque monkey resembles a human in form,
and is extremely clever in nature,
simply climbing windows, getting on tables,
opening plates, overturning jars,
pulling sleeves, tugging at clothes,
scratching lice,
playing with its genitalia,
its demeanor is extremely unrefined.
Moreover, after many years,
how could it not cause trouble?
There is also a larger kind,
which is called an ape (*yuán*),
and is even more agile.
Among the apes, there is also a kind with connecting arms (*tōngbì*),
Both arms are connected,
whichever arm he extends on that side,
the arm on this side will retract,
and one arm can extend out.
Therefore, they are skilled at scaling cliffs and climbing trees,
when people use arrows to shoot at them,
if it comes from the right, they catch it with the right,
if it comes from the left, they catch it with the left,
if it comes from close, they catch it close,
if it comes from far, they catch it far,
they are not afraid at all.
There are also those who have attained enlightenment over many years,
skilled in understanding *yīnyáng*,
capable of casting spells,
with vast supernatural powers,
too numerous to describe.
How is this seen?
Just see:
Born in the *Shēn* position,
descendants come from *Bā Shān*,
born in the *Shēn* position,
the descendants of *Shēn Yáng* Guan live together,
descendants come from *Bā Shān*,
the clans of the Marquis of *Bāxī* flourish.
Soft-hearted and easily heartbroken when howling at the bright moon,
who would not feel sorrow?
Long arms able to reach the treetops,
what to fear from skilled archers?
Hé chóu shàn shè? (Why worry about being good at archery?)
Shùxué chuán Fēng Hòu, (His mathematics were passed down from Fēng Hòu,)
shuí zhī shì qián dài lì shī, (who knew he was a calendar master from a previous dynasty,)
dāofǎ shòu Yún Cháng, (His saber techniques were taught to Yún Cháng,)
cuò rèn zuò rénjiān jiànxiá, (wrongly identified as a swordsman among mortals,)
shéntōng què shì Xiáng Lóng zǔ, (his supernatural powers were actually those of the Dragon-Subduing ancestor,)
biànhuà píng qī Bì Mǎ Wēn. (and his transformations could easily deceive Bì Mǎ Wēn.)
Huà shuō Chūnqiū Zhōu Jìng Wáng shí, (It is said that during the reign of King Jìng of Zhōu in the Spring and Autumn period,)
Wú Yuè jiāozhēng, (Wú and Yuè were at war.)
Wú Wáng Fūchāi, (King Fūchāi of Wú,)
wéikùn Yuè Wáng Gōujiàn yú Kuàijī Shān zhī shàng, (besieged King Gōujiàn of Yuè on Mount Kuàijī,)
kuī dé xià dàfū Wén Zhǒng, (Fortunately, the high official Wén Zhǒng,)
bēi cí hòulǐ qù qǐng Xíng Chéng, (humbly and respectfully requested Xíng Chéng,)
Wú Wáng yī yǔn, (King Wú agreed,)
jiāng Yuè Wáng fūfù zhāi qù guānfú, (and had King and Queen of Yuè stripped of their crowns and robes,)
qiú yú shíshì zhī zhōng, (and imprisoned in a stone chamber,)
tì Wú guó yǎng mǎ sān nián, (to raise horses for Wú for three years,)
fāng shǐ fàng huí. (before finally being released.)
Yuè Wáng yīxīn yào bào cǐ chóu, (King Yuè was determined to avenge this humiliation,)
xiǎng Wú guó yǒu yúcháng zhī jiàn sānqiān, (but he knew that the state of Wú had three thousand "fish intestine" swords,)
nányǐ dǐdí, (which would be difficult to resist.)
Yǒu shàng dàfū Fàn Lǐ xiàn jì, (The high official Fàn Lǐ offered a plan,)
tiāoxuǎn liùqiān jūnzǐ jūn, (to select six thousand gentlemen soldiers,)
zhāoxī xùnliàn; (and train them day and night;)
fǎng dé Nánshān yǒu gè chǔnǚ, (He learned that in the Southern Mountains there was a virgin,)
jīngtōng jiànshù, (who was proficient in swordsmanship.)
Fèng Yuè Wáng zhī mìng, (By order of the King of Yuè,)
pìnqǐng tā wéi guóshī. (he invited her to be the national instructor.)
The virgin packed up and went down the mountain.
On the way,
she met an old white-haired man,
who called himself Yuán Gōng.
He said to the virgin:
"I have heard that the young lady is proficient in swordsmanship,
and I, an old man, have a rough understanding of it.
I would like to invite you to test it."
The virgin said:
"I dare not hide my skills,
but I will rely on the old man to test me."
Yuán Gōng looked at the treetop,
revealing a dry bamboo pole,
jumped up,
and had already pulled it up,
throwing it into the air to fall down.
The bamboo pole, facing the wind,
snapped in two with a crack.
The virgin caught the bamboo tip,
Yuán Gōng caught the bamboo root,
and Yuán Gōng used the momentum to stab the virgin.
The virgin did not panic,
catching the bamboo tip,
and turned around to stab Yuán Gōng.
Yuán Gōng flew to the treetop,
transformed into a white ape, and left.
It turned out that the virgin was no ordinary person,
but a manifestation of Jiǔtiān Xuánnǚ (the Dark Lady of the Ninth Heaven).
Because the King of Wú was without principle,
the Jade Emperor sent the Xuánnǚ to descend to earth,
to help Yuè destroy Wú.
That Yuán Gōng was a white gibbon who had cultivated the Dao for many years in the state of Chǔ.
Because King Gòng of Chǔ was hunting at Mount Jīng,
he consecutively caught eighteen of the king's imperial arrows.
King Gòng was furious.
He summoned Yǎng Yóujī, the best archer in Chǔ, famous for his ability to shoot through a willow leaf at a hundred paces.
to come and shoot him.
The white gibbon knew that Yǎng Yóujī was a divine archer,
and unable to dodge in time,
he vanished in a puff of smoke.
King Gòng ordered the entire army to surround the mountain peak,
searching without finding him,
and burned all the trees on the mountain.
To this day, the saying "Chǔ destroyed the gibbon,
and the disaster spread to the trees" is still told.
That is why.
From then on, the white gibbon hid in the White Cloud Cave in the Yúnmèng Mountains,
concentrating on cultivating the Dao.
Today, knowing that the Xuánnǚ had descended,
he deliberately transformed into Yuán Gōng
to test her swordsmanship.
Later, the maiden met the King of Yuè,
and trained six thousand elite troops.
She did not report back to Fàn Lǐ,
nor did she take her leave from the King of Yuè,
She departed swiftly and gracefully.
There is a poem to prove it:
Xuán Nǚ's divine plan is not recklessly cast,
Six thousand gentlemen are but commoners;
To know a little of the wonders of Heaven,
Is already the foremost skill on Earth.
It is said that the maiden descended Nánshān,
and came to the Yuè kingdom.
At that time, the king of Yuè had sent people to greet the arriving crowd,
with fragrant carriages and precious horses,
needless to say.
Today she leaves without bidding farewell,
but could not avoid being alone,
half in clouds and half in mist,
traveling to the old road.
She only heard a voice from within the dense forest calling out "Xuán Nǚ Niángniáng,"
and another calling out "Shīfu."
The maiden stopped her cloud,
and when she looked with her wise eyes,
it turned out to be Yuán Gōng, kneeling with both knees,
holding a stone platter with both hands.
On the platter were arranged four types of longevity fruits,
his mouth only calling out:
"Shīfu,
pity your disciple's sincere heart,
take me in and teach me!"
Furthermore, the four kinds of longevity fruits
were hazelnuts,
Sōngzǐ (Pine nuts),
fěizǐ (Chinese nutmeg-yew nuts),
hétao (walnuts).
If we consider the oranges and
yòuzǐ (pomelos) and
yángméi (Chinese bayberries) of the southeast, and the
línqín (crabapples),
pears, and
zǎo (jujubes) of the northwest,
these are all fine items,
but ultimately they are only valued for being fresh and seasonal,
and cannot last for long.
Only those four types are stored within shells,
the wind doesn't dry them,
the rain doesn't wet them,
and they remain as good as new for a long time.
Therefore, they are called "long-life fruits,"
and are forever the staple food of mountain families.
Later, painters of *dānqīng* (traditional Chinese painting) created the "White Ape Presenting Fruit" painting,
which is based on this story.
At that moment, Yuán Gōng put down the stone plate,
repeatedly kowtowing,
and exclaimed,
"Master must take in this disciple here.
That maiden, after he recognized her as an incarnation of the Jiǔtiān Xuánnǚ Niángniáng (the Dark Lady of the Nine Heavens),
said:
'Unexpectedly, this old man is quite clever!'
Seeing his great sincerity,
Then she took one of each of the four kinds of fruit he had offered.
One from each kind.
This was to acknowledge his goodwill.
The rest she distributed to the servants sent by the Yuè King as an act of merit.
Then Yuán Gōng, in the dense forest,
properly and respectfully,
knelt on both knees.
The Xuánnǚ received his obeisance,
and from her sleeve took out two pellets, as large as round eyes,
and gave them to Yuán Gōng.
Yuán Gōng accepted them with both hands,
placing them in his palms.
Looking at these pellets, they seemed as if cast from pig iron,
not very shiny.
Though Yuán Gōng's mouth said nothing,
in his heart he was doubtful,
thinking:
"If they were two dumplings made of flour,
they would at least be good for filling my stomach.
Even if they were made of silver,
they wouldn't weigh more than two taels,
not good for much.
If they are just two lead bullets,
old Yuán here doesn't know how to shoot pellets,
what would I want them for?"
While he hesitated in his heart,
the Xuánnǚ already knew his thoughts.
Then she blew a breath onto the pellets,
He cried out the word "jí"
and immediately saw a light burst forth.
In a short while,
it leaped to the left,
and jumped to the right,
like two golden snakes entwining and circling.
They darted back and forth, only above his head and around his neck,
emitting countless rays of cold light,
so chilling it was unbearable.
In his ears, it sounded like thousands of swords and blades clashing and stabbing,
terrifying Yuán Gōng so much that he tightly closed his eyes,
and kept exclaiming:
"Good master!
Your disciple now knows of master's divine power,
please forgive me!
So these two pellets,
are actually two swords, male and female, forged by immortals,
able to extend and contract,
with endless transformations.
When they are captured by the light,
they look like two lead pellets,
but if they leap up,
they can rampage through millions of soldiers,
moving horizontally and charging straight ahead,
coming like arrows,
going like the wind.
Therefore, when immortals send out lead pellets,
they hit the target every single time.
Today, the Xuán Nǚ only slightly displayed a supernatural power to frighten Yuán Gōng;
although it was fierce,
it only shaved off some hair from his head and eyebrows,
with no other damage.
If his heart were not sincere,
even ten thousand heads would have been taken off."
